crossRefs.note: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
“Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came…
Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’ ”
The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things are to us, that you do so?”

translations.web: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’
translations.bsb: When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you explain to us what you mean by these?’
translations.kjv: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew
translations.asv: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not show us what thou meanest by these?
